text:
ci-bot: Pipeline alert: main branch build #4821 failed on stage `smoke-gpu` (step: allocator-init). Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/4821 :rotating_light:

jamie: ugh, who merged to main ~10m ago? :eyes:

sofia: that was me, merged PR #4567 (model-routing fix). I ran local smoke, passed. Not sure how it hit allocator-init here.

matt: log snippet:
```
Allocating GPUs: device 0 OK
KV cache init...
allocator: failed to reserve 1.2G, OOM -> fallback failed
ERROR: failed to mmap cache: EINVAL
```
Looks like a binary cache/mmap issue rather than model code.

alex: could be a libc/libcxx mismatch on the runners after the image update earlier today. Anyone on infra change?

jamie: infra-deploy-bot shows a container image roll at 7381234000 by infra-ci (libc update). That might line up.

sofia: hmm, my PR touched routing only. If it's binary image, we should rerun on a different pool. Can someone rerun and pin pool to `gpu-stable-2`?

jamie: queued manual rerun on gpu-stable-2 -> https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/4821/rerun/1 :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Rerun started (build 4821.1) on gpu-stable-2.

oncall: I'll take this. If rerun passes, fine. If it fails again, I'll start a bisect across the container-image roll.

ci-bot: Rerun finished -> FAILURE (same allocator-init OOM).

oncall: OK failing reproducibly on gpu-stable-2 too. Next step: bisect container image roll. Who can provide the exact image digest used by the failing build?

matt: build artifact metadata: image sha256:abc123def456 (from failing run). The stable pool uses sha256:abc123aaa000 before the infra roll.

sofia: if it's an image-level regression we should revert the infra image roll and re-run main. Can infra rollback quickly?

jamie: pinging @infra-team: we need rollback of image sha256:abc123def456 -> abc123aaa000 to stabilize main.

alex: small mitigation: set allocator env var to disable mmap cache (`REDWOOD_ALLOC_MMAP=0`) for the smoke job until rollback. But that's risky for performance; prefer rollback.

oncall: For immediate safety, I'll patch the smoke job to set REDWOOD_ALLOC_MMAP=0 and re-run. If that greenlights main, we can schedule image rollback and full bisect during quiet window.

sofia: thanks. If rollback will be >30m, patch sounds good. Keep me posted and I'll hold on the PR revert for now. :ok_hand:

ci-bot: Rerun (with REDWOOD_ALLOC_MMAP=0) started -> https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/4821/rerun/2

ci-bot: Rerun finished -> SUCCESS.

oncall: Good — main is green now. I'll file an infra incident with the image roll details and request rollback & bisect: https://infra.internal/incidents/INC-2026.

jamie: awesome, thanks oncall and infra. Sofia, no revert needed for your PR at the moment.

sofia: thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) infra rollback + bisect, 2) add a smoke job matrix to test both image variants before promoting image.

matt: agreed. I'll add the matrix proposal as a quick PR.

alex: triage complete. Marking thread resolved unless incident shows otherwise. :white_check_mark:
